Two side-by-side graphs. Graph 1 (left) shows a "Change in Quantity Supplied": A single upward-sloping supply curve with two points, A and B. An arrow points from A to B along the curve, showing price increasing from P1 to P2 and quantity increasing from Q1 to Q2. Title: "Movement along the curve". Graph 2 (right) shows a "Change in Supply": Three separate upward-sloping supply curves labeled S1 (original), S2 (right shift), and S3 (left shift). A horizontal dashed line shows price remains constant at P1, while arrows point right from Q1 to Q2 (increase in supply) and left from Q1 to Q3 (decrease in supply). Title: "Shift of the curve".

A 45-degree upward line starting from the origin labeled PES=1 (Unitary elastic). 4. A flatter upward-sloping line labeled PES>1 (Elastic). 5.
